catalogSnapshot.name: Azure Databricks Well-Architected & Lakehouse Dependency Review

interpretation: Local rule-resource indicators, not an official Microsoft Well-Architected assessment, certification or Databricks audit grade.
Dependency edges distinguish OBSERVED native ID/key joins from explicit INFERRED URI/host references and UNKNOWN runtime lineage.

Control-plane REST API reads never start clusters or SQL warehouses and never execute billable SQL queries against system.access.table_lineage; system.billing.usage is queried only when the operator sets system_tables_warehouse_id (off by default; that one fixed statement consumes DBUs and can start the chosen warehouse).
Cross-tenant collection requires explicit administrator-configured federation or Azure Lighthouse delegation; a single-tenant SRE UAMI never acquires foreign-tenant tokens implicitly.
Configuration presence does not prove effective firewall enforcement, data-plane network reachability, least-privilege Unity Catalog grants or workload SLA compliance.

rules.title: Premium SKU for governance and security controls
rules.recommendation: Confirm the Premium tier for production workloads that need Unity Catalog, role-based access control and advanced auditing.
rules.business_impact: A tier below Premium can limit identity controls, Unity Catalog and access isolation.

rules.title: Secure cluster connectivity (no public IP)
rules.recommendation: Enable enableNoPublicIp on the workspace so compute nodes have no public IP addresses and reach the control plane through an outbound relay.
rules.business_impact: Cluster nodes with public IP addresses increase the network exposure of the data plane.

rules.title: VNet injection into a customer-managed network
rules.recommendation: When the corporate network architecture requires it, deploy the workspace with customVirtualNetworkId and dedicated host and container subnets.
rules.business_impact: The default managed VNet prevents custom routes, egress inspection and granular peering.

rules.title: Public network restriction and Private Link for the workspace
rules.recommendation: Review publicNetworkAccess, requiredNsgRules and the approved private endpoint connections against your private isolation requirements.
rules.business_impact: Open public access without compensating controls widens the entry surface of the workspace.

rules.title: Access connector with managed identity and storage firewall
rules.recommendation: Link an Azure Databricks access connector with a managed identity (SystemAssigned or UserAssigned) and review defaultStorageFirewall.
rules.business_impact: Without an access connector, the workspace can't use a managed identity to authenticate to governed storage.

rules.title: Customer-managed key (CMK) and infrastructure encryption
rules.recommendation: If your compliance policy requires CMK, configure Key Vault keys for managedServices and managedDisk with automatic rotation.
rules.business_impact: Without CMK where regulation requires it, the customer doesn't directly control cryptographic revocation.

rules.title: Enhanced security profile and automatic cluster update
rules.recommendation: Evaluate enhancedSecurityMonitoring, automaticClusterUpdate and complianceSecurityProfile when specific regulations apply.
rules.business_impact: Without automatic updates or the required enhanced monitoring, agent maintenance depends on manual processes.

rules.title: Diagnostic settings on the ARM control plane
rules.recommendation: Send audit categories through Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings to Log Analytics, Storage or Event Hubs and verify the ingestion.
rules.business_impact: Without diagnostic logs, control-plane, job and access events are harder to trace.

rules.title: Personal access token (PAT) governance in workspace-conf
rules.recommendation: Review enableTokensConfig and prefer OAuth M2M authentication or Microsoft Entra managed identities over long-lived PATs.
rules.business_impact: Personal tokens without issuance or expiry control increase the risk of persistent credentials.

rules.title: Unity Catalog as the default catalog instead of legacy Hive
rules.recommendation: Set UnityCatalog as the default catalog and avoid storing business data in the DBFS root or hive_metastore.
rules.business_impact: Using hive_metastore and the DBFS root makes unified access control and data lineage harder.

rules.title: Global init script hygiene and review
rules.recommendation: Minimize or audit the enabled global init scripts and prefer cluster policies or init scripts stored in Unity Catalog volumes.
rules.business_impact: Global init scripts run on every cluster in the workspace and can introduce hidden dependencies or points of failure.

rules.title: Review of cached Azure Advisor recommendations
rules.recommendation: Check the cached Azure Advisor recommendations for the workspace and its associated resources as a complementary input.
rules.business_impact: Ignoring platform alerts can delay finding reliability or cost improvements.

rules.title: Auto-termination on interactive all-purpose clusters
rules.recommendation: Set autotermination_minutes (for example 60 minutes or less) on every all-purpose cluster to avoid idle DBU and VM consumption.
rules.business_impact: An interactive cluster without auto-termination, or with a high threshold, keeps nodes billing with no active workload.

rules.title: Clusters governed by a cluster policy
rules.recommendation: Attach a policy_id to clusters to enforce limits on instance type, auto-termination, runtime version and FinOps tags.
rules.business_impact: Creating clusters without a policy allows non-standard configurations and accidental overspending.

rules.title: Compute access mode compatible with isolation and Unity Catalog
rules.recommendation: Set data_security_mode to USER_ISOLATION (Standard/Shared) or SINGLE_USER (Dedicated) and avoid modes without isolation (NONE).
rules.business_impact: Legacy or non-isolated access modes prevent Unity Catalog controls or allow ungoverned direct access.

rules.title: Supported Databricks Runtime version (LTS / current)
rules.recommendation: Keep spark_version on a current Long Term Support (LTS) version (for example 13.3 LTS, 14.3 LTS, 15.4 LTS or later).
rules.business_impact: Old Databricks Runtime versions lose support, security patches and Photon/Delta optimizations.

rules.title: Autoscaling or instance pool on clusters
rules.recommendation: Evaluate autoscale (min_workers/max_workers) or an instance_pool_id binding to match capacity to workload changes.
rules.business_impact: A fixed number of workers without a pool can leave resources idle in quiet periods or limit concurrency at peaks.

rules.title: Scheduled jobs on job compute or serverless instead of all-purpose
rules.recommendation: Move job tasks that point to existing_cluster_id to job_cluster_key or serverless job compute.
rules.business_impact: Running automated jobs on all-purpose clusters costs higher DBU rates and couples failures across workloads.

rules.title: Timeouts, retries or notifications on orchestration jobs
rules.recommendation: Configure timeout_seconds, retry policies and notifications or alerts on critical jobs to detect hung or failed runs.
rules.business_impact: A job without a timeout or alerts can hang while consuming resources, or miss data windows without warning.

rules.title: Jobs run as a service principal (run_as)
rules.recommendation: Set run_as to a dedicated service principal instead of an individual user account, so jobs don't fail when people leave or change roles.
rules.business_impact: Jobs that run under a user identity fail if the user leaves the organization or loses permissions.

rules.title: Auto-stop and serverless/pro architecture on SQL warehouses
rules.recommendation: Set auto_stop_mins (30 minutes or less) or use serverless SQL warehouses for BI and interactive workloads with variable demand.
rules.business_impact: A SQL warehouse without auto-stop keeps billable capacity running outside query windows.

rules.title: Declarative pipelines (Lakeflow / DLT) published to Unity Catalog
rules.recommendation: Set a Unity Catalog catalog on declarative pipelines to get native lineage and table governance.
rules.business_impact: Pipelines published to hive_metastore fall outside the central permission and lineage model.

rules.title: Unity Catalog metastore assigned to the workspace
rules.recommendation: Link the workspace to a regional Unity Catalog metastore to centralize identities, access control, auditing and lineage.
rules.business_impact: Without an attached metastore, unified governance, external locations and system tables aren't available.

rules.title: Unity Catalog storage credentials based on managed identity
rules.recommendation: Use an Azure managed identity (through an access connector) in Unity Catalog storage credentials instead of service principal secrets.
rules.business_impact: Secret-based credentials need manual rotation and raise the risk if they leak.

rules.title: External locations with a valid storage credential and explicit ADLS Gen2 paths
rules.recommendation: Check that each external location links to an existing storage credential, uses abfss:// and applies workspace binding where appropriate.
rules.business_impact: Orphaned or non-isolated external locations can expose containers shared across environments.

rules.title: Secret scopes backed by Azure Key Vault
rules.recommendation: Prefer secret scopes with the AZURE_KEYVAULT backend over local DATABRICKS scopes when you need central secret management.
rules.business_impact: Local Databricks scopes don't integrate directly with Azure Key Vault rotation and audit policies.

rules.title: Referential integrity of the job, compute and governance dependency map
rules.recommendation: Fix broken references in job tasks (deleted clusters, SQL warehouses that don't exist, missing pipelines or child jobs, and unresolved credentials).
rules.business_impact: A broken dependency observed in a job definition causes immediate run failures in production.

rules.title: Runtime table and column lineage (system.access.table_lineage)
rules.recommendation: If you need runtime lineage at table or column level, enable and query system.access.table_lineage in an authorized session; this collector never starts compute to do it.
rules.business_impact: Control-plane analysis maps declared dependencies, not the dynamic SQL reads and writes inside notebooks.

rules.title: Governance of external connections in Unity Catalog (Lakehouse Federation)
rules.recommendation: Inventory the Lakehouse Federation connections in Unity Catalog and check their network and credential dependencies.
rules.business_impact: Federated external connections are critical dependencies on third-party SQL engines or platforms.

rules.title: Visibility of outbound network dependencies (outboundNetworkDependenciesEndpoints)
rules.recommendation: Compare the firewall, UDR and NSG rules with the official list of outbound endpoints that the workspace needs to reach the control plane.
rules.business_impact: Blocking required outbound dependencies (Webapp, Control Plane NAT, Storage, Metastore, EventHub/ServiceBus) prevents clusters from starting.

rules.title: Associated storage accounts with HTTPS, TLS 1.2+ and no public blob access
rules.recommendation: Require supportsHttpsTrafficOnly=true, minimumTlsVersion=TLS1_2 and allowBlobPublicAccess=false on the associated ADLS Gen2 accounts.
rules.business_impact: Allowing unencrypted traffic or anonymous container access exposes lakehouse assets.

rules.title: Shared key and network access restriction on associated storage accounts
rules.recommendation: Evaluate disabling allowSharedKeyAccess and restricting publicNetworkAccess on ADLS Gen2 accounts governed by Microsoft Entra ID / Unity Catalog.
rules.business_impact: Account shared keys bypass the granular identity controls of Microsoft Entra and Unity Catalog.

rules.title: RBAC authorization and purge protection on associated key vaults
rules.recommendation: Enable enableRbacAuthorization and enablePurgeProtection on the key vaults linked to secret scopes or to the workspace CMK keys.
rules.business_impact: Without purge protection, accidental or malicious deletion of a CMK key or secret can be irreversible.

rules.title: Administrative ports exposed to the internet on associated NSGs
rules.recommendation: Remove or restrict inbound Allow rules from the internet (0.0.0.0/0, *, Internet) to SSH (22), RDP (3389) or all ports on the workspace subnets.
rules.business_impact: Inbound rules open to the internet on cluster subnets break data-plane isolation.

rules.title: Approved state on associated private endpoint connections
rules.recommendation: Confirm that every private endpoint connection associated with the workspace or its linked resources is in the Approved state.
rules.business_impact: A private endpoint in the Pending, Rejected or Disconnected state breaks the intended private connectivity.

rules.title: Actual cost attribution (ActualCost) and DBU granularity by workload
rules.recommendation: Combine the observed ARM actual costs with cluster and job tagging and the system.billing.usage table to attribute DBU consumption by team or pipeline.
rules.business_impact: ActualCost at Azure ResourceId level doesn't break down, on its own, the internal consumption of each job, SQL warehouse or user.
